description: Full-length LIR scan of C. elegans FNDC-1 by topological compartment, plus summary figure of LIR conservation across FUN14 orthologs
code:
import requests, re, time
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

panel = {
 "Q8IVP5":"Hs_FUNDC1","Q9DB70":"Mm_FUNDC1","Q5BJS4":"Rn_FUNDC1","E1BWM5":"Gg_FUNDC1",
 "B1H3B1":"Xt_FUNDC1","Q6DH87":"Dr_FUNDC1","Q9BWH2":"Hs_FUNDC2","P18411":"Sc_FUN14",
 "Q22252":"Cel_FNDC-1","A8WT57":"Cbr_fndc-1","A0A2G5V2J1":"Cni_FUN14","A0A1I7T0Q0":"Ctr_FUN14",
 "A0A8R1HQB4":"Cja_FUN14","A0A8S1EWU7":"Cbo_FUN14","A0A7E4UMM2":"Pre_FUN14","A0A914Y074":"Psu_FUN14",
 "A0A1I7SAN2":"Bxy_FUN14","A0A915DHH3":"Ddi_FUN14","A0A1I8BQP0":"Mha_FUN14","A0A0N4ZS05":"Ptr_FUN14"}
seqs={}
for acc,lab in panel.items():
    seqs[lab]=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json",timeout=60).json()["sequence"]["value"]

cel=seqs["Cel_FNDC-1"]; hs=seqs["Hs_FUNDC1"]
# UniProt topology: Cel TM1 37-56, TM2 61-78 (third hydrophobic helix ~121-138 unannotated)
cel_topo=[("N-term cytosolic",1,36),("TM1",37,56),("IMS loop",57,60),("TM2",61,78),
          ("cytosolic loop (inferred)",79,120),("TM3 (inferred, unannotated)",121,138)]
print("=== Full-length [WFY]xx[LIV] scan of C. elegans FNDC-1 (Q22252), by compartment ===")
rows=[]
for m in re.finditer(r"(?=([WFY]..[LIV]))", cel):
    p=m.start()+1; mot=m.group(1)
    comp=[n for n,a,b in cel_topo if a<=p<=b][0]
    up=cel[max(0,p-5):p-1]
    rows.append(dict(pos=p,motif=mot,upstream4=up,acidic_DE_up4=sum(c in "DE" for c in up),
                     ST_up4=sum(c in "ST" for c in up),compartment=comp))
cz=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(cz.to_string(index=False))
cz.to_csv("table4_Cel_FNDC1_fulllength_LIRscan.csv",index=False)

print("\n=== Human FUNDC1 reference LIR context ===")
print("  Hs FUNDC1 14-22 = %s ; LIR Y18-E19-V20-L21 ; upstream D15 D16 S17 (3/4 acidic, S17=ULK1 site)"%hs[13:22])
print("  Cel FNDC-1 best core hit = YYVV 27-30 ; upstream DTVL (1/4 acidic, 0 D/E at -1..-3)")

# ---------------- Figure ----------------
order=["Hs_FUNDC1","Mm_FUNDC1","Rn_FUNDC1","Gg_FUNDC1","Xt_FUNDC1","Dr_FUNDC1","Hs_FUNDC2","Sc_FUN14",
       "Cel_FNDC-1","Cbr_fndc-1","Cni_FUN14","Ctr_FUN14","Cja_FUN14","Cbo_FUN14",
       "Pre_FUN14","Psu_FUN14","Bxy_FUN14","Ddi_FUN14","Ptr_FUN14","Mha_FUN14"]
# aligned LIR window from the Clustal Omega MSA computed earlier (re-run here for provenance)
fasta="".join(f">{l}\n{s}\n" for l,s in seqs.items())
base="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/Tools/services/rest/clustalo"
jid=requests.post(base+"/run",data=dict(email="a.scientist@ebi.ac.uk",sequence=fasta,
    stype="protein",outfmt="clustal_num"),timeout=90).text.strip()
st="RUNNING"
while st=="RUNNING":
    time.sleep(4); st=requests.get(f"{base}/status/{jid}",timeout=60).text.strip()
aln_txt=requests.get(f"{base}/result/{jid}/aln-clustal_num",timeout=90).text
aln={}
for line in aln_txt.splitlines()[1:]:
    m=re.match(r"^(\S+)\s+([A-Za-z\-]+)\s*\d*$",line)
    if m and m.group(1) in seqs: aln[m.group(1)]=aln.get(m.group(1),"")+m.group(2)
i=0; h2c={}
for c,ch in enumerate(aln["Hs_FUNDC1"]):
    if ch!="-": i+=1; h2c[i]=c
win=[h2c[p] for p in range(10,25)]            # human D10..T24
labels=[hs[p-1]+str(p) for p in range(10,25)]

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(15,7),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[2.1,1]})
ax=axes[0]
acid=set("DE"); arom=set("WFY"); hyd=set("LIV")
for r,lab in enumerate(order):
    for k,c in enumerate(win):
        ch=aln[lab][c]
        face="#f2f2f2"; txtcol="#555"
        if ch=="-": face="#ffffff"
        elif ch in acid: face="#d94f4f"; txtcol="white"
        elif ch in arom: face="#2f6fb5"; txtcol="white"
        elif ch in hyd: face="#7fb069"; txtcol="white"
        elif ch in "ST": face="#f0c419"
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((k,-r),1,1,facecolor=face,edgecolor="#bbbbbb",lw=.5))
        ax.text(k+.5,-r+.5,ch if ch!="-" else "",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=11,color=txtcol)
# box the LIR core columns (human Y18-L21)
cstart=win.index(h2c[18]); cend=win.index(h2c[21])
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((cstart,-len(order)+1),cend-cstart+1,len(order),fill=False,edgecolor="black",lw=2.2))
ax.set_xlim(0,len(win)); ax.set_ylim(-len(order)+1,1)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(len(win))+.5); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,rotation=90,fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(-np.arange(len(order))+.5); ax.set_yticklabels(order,fontsize=10)
ax.set_title("Clustal Omega alignment around the human FUNDC1 LIR (boxed: Y18-E19-V20-L21)\n"
             "red D/E, blue W/F/Y, green L/I/V, yellow S/T",fontsize=11)
ax.set_aspect("equal"); [s.set_visible(False) for s in ax.spines.values()]

ax2=axes[1]
# acidic content of the 4 residues upstream of the best N-terminal LIR core hit, per species
best={"Hs_FUNDC1":("YEVL",3),"Mm_FUNDC1":("YEVL",3),"Rn_FUNDC1":("YEVL",3),"Gg_FUNDC1":("YEVL",3),
      "Xt_FUNDC1":("YEVL",3),"Dr_FUNDC1":("YEVV",3),"Hs_FUNDC2":("FESL",1),"Sc_FUN14":("FRNL",0),
      "Cel_FNDC-1":("YYVV",1),"Cbr_fndc-1":("none",0),"Cni_FUN14":("none",0),"Ctr_FUN14":("none",0),
      "Cja_FUN14":("none",0),"Cbo_FUN14":("none",0),"Pre_FUN14":("FRNI",0),"Psu_FUN14":("FRYL",1),
      "Bxy_FUN14":("FRYL",1),"Ddi_FUN14":("FGYL",1),"Ptr_FUN14":("none",0),"Mha_FUN14":("none",0)}
y=-np.arange(len(order)); vals=[best[l][1] for l in order]
cols=["#2f6fb5" if "FUNDC1" in l and l!="Hs_FUNDC2" else ("#999999" if l in("Hs_FUNDC2","Sc_FUN14") else "#d98c2b") for l in order]
ax2.barh(y+.5,vals,height=.7,color=cols)
for k,l in enumerate(order):
    ax2.text(0.08,-k+.5,best[l][0],va="center",fontsize=9,
             color="white" if best[l][1]>0 else "#333333")
ax2.set_yticks([]); ax2.set_xlim(0,4); ax2.set_xlabel("acidic (D/E) residues in positions -4..-1")
ax2.set_ylim(-len(order)+1,1)
ax2.set_title("Best [WFY]xx[LIV] core in the\nN-terminal cytosolic tail, and its acidic flank",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
